Waitlist Privacy Notice

Last updated: November 13, 2026

Scope: This notice covers the COR launch waitlist, related marketing emails and support messages about the waitlist. It is not the privacy policy for the COR iPhone or Apple Watch apps.

What we collect and why

When you join the COR waitlist, we collect your email address and record your subscription choice, signup source and date. We use Brevo to manage the list and send COR launch news and occasional product updates.

Email tracking

Brevo records email delivery, opens, clicks and unsubscribe activity. Open and click tracking can associate your interaction with your email address and collect technical information such as your IP address. We use this information to understand email delivery and engagement.

Spam protection

We use Cloudflare Turnstile to help protect the signup form from automated abuse. Turnstile processes technical information, including IP address and browser information, to distinguish legitimate visitors from automated traffic.

Support messages

If you contact support@coractive.co, we receive your email address and the contents of your message. Support email is routed through Cloudflare and Google services so we can receive and respond to your request. Please do not send health information when asking about the waitlist.

Unsubscribing and retention

You can unsubscribe at any time using the link in our emails. Unsubscribing stops future COR marketing emails; it does not automatically delete your Brevo contact record or email history. We retain the unsubscribe status to help prevent further marketing messages. To request deletion of your information, contact support@coractive.co.

Your choices

You can contact support@coractive.co to ask about access, correction or deletion of your waitlist information. This waitlist does not require you to create an app account or provide health information.

Questions? Contact support@coractive.co
